excerpt_i18n.en: July 27, 2026, Shenzhen — OPPO announced the launch of the "Xiaobu Next Plan," opening the industry's first on-device Multi-Agent collaborative system for internal testing. Equipped with the industry's first on-device global memory system, Xiaobu Next delivers significantly enhanced user understanding and proactive service capabilities. Through the Xiaobu Next Plan, OPPO aims to explore the potential of on-device AI in proactive intelligent services together with AI power users and enthusiasts. Capabilities validated in the plan will be continuously integrated into OPPO's AI products in the future. Pete Lau, OPPO's Chief Product Officer, stated, "Proactive intelligence will be the true turning point for AI phones. The next generation of AI should proactively perceive needs and serve users, truly becoming their intelligent companion. Through the Xiaobu Next Plan, we hope to bring this future forward." Running on the device allows AI to understand you better and be more secure. Xiaobu Next provides an underlying on-device Agent system that handles context understanding, task planning, and intelligent scheduling locally. Relying on the on-device Agent architecture and the industry's first on-device global memory system, Xiaobu Next can continuously learn user habits, long-term goals, and contextual information with user authorization, offering more personalized services through enhanced AI memory capabilities. For example, when a user asks, "Recommend a book suitable for me," Xiaobu Next does not just rely on popular lists.
excerpt_i18n.es: 27 de julio de 2026, Shenzhen — OPPO anuncia el inicio del «Plan Xiaobu Next», abriendo la primera prueba interna del sistema de cooperación multiagente en el extremo del dispositivo de la industria. «Xiaobu Next» incorpora el primer sistema de memoria global en el extremo del dispositivo de la industria, proporcionando una capacidad de comprensión del usuario integralmente mejorada y una capacidad de servicio proactivo avanzada. A través del Plan Xiaobu Next, OPPO espera explorar junto con usuarios profesionales de IA y entusiastas de la tecnología de IA el potencial de la IA en el extremo del dispositivo en cuanto al servicio inteligente proactivo. Las capacidades verificadas en el Plan Xiaobu Next se integrarán continuamente en los productos de IA de OPPO en el futuro.

items.raw_excerpt: 2026年 ， 教育部等五部门印发《“人工智能+教育”行动计划》，文件明确要求分层提升教师AI数字素养，全面构建人机协同的新型课堂模式。政策方向已然明朗，但落地层面的讨论仍在发酵。7月23日，复旦大学副校长周磊在接受人民网专访时表示：“智能化转型浪潮下，教学创新比任何时候都更关乎教育本质。”他同时指出，一线教师 首要的能力迭代，是从“AI工具使用者”转向“智能教学设计者”。 这句话精准点出当众多学校共同面临的深层焦虑—— 教育AI应用并不稀缺，但多数浮于表面，难以真正服务因材施教， 教师转型缺少完整支撑体系。 当前AI赋能教育存在三大结构性难题： 第一，师资结构性缺口难以消解。 县域、乡村学校骨干教师稀缺，大班额下教师无力兼顾后进生补差与优等生拔高，大量时间消耗在学情统计、习题整理等标准化工作，无暇开展价值引领、情感浸润等AI不可替代的育人工作； 第二，AI应用浅层化难以突破。 市面上碎片化智能产品只能完成内容推送，无法仿真学生真实思维短板，教师缺少完整理论框架支撑个性化教学设计，很难转型为课堂“总导演”与学习设计师； 第三，教师AI转型缺少配套体系。 各校零散采购工具、自主摸索融合路径，试错成本高昂，同时学生心智数据安全、AI学术伦理缺少统一规范，学校不敢大规模推广智能教学。 换言之，行业需要的不再是单点工具，而是从普惠、认知到治理的体系化能力。近期的一些行业实践，提供了可供观察的样本。 一线普惠实践：“一生一案”补齐师资短板，回归价值育人核心 推进教育均衡、缩小城乡校际差距，是《“人工智能+教育”行动计划》核心任务之一。偏远县域学校普遍存在师资薄弱问题，城市教师则深陷机械性教学事务，分层教学长期难以落地。天立启鸣打造的“天立学科大脑・一生一案”个性化学习方案，从全球40个国家267份申报案例中脱颖而出，成功入选联合国ITU 2026 AI for Good全球创新案例，

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Shenzhen Chaowei Power Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. ("Chaowei Power") and PKU Healthcare Management Co., Ltd. ("PKU Healthcare") have reached an in-depth collaboration. The two parties will jointly innovate around data collection, world models, and simulation training for embodied intelligence in medical scenarios, pragmatically building a complete implementation pathway from "simulated training" to "scenario validation" and then to "hospital application." For embodied intelligence to truly enter hospitals, it is never as simple as placing a robot directly into a ward. It first needs to understand the hospital and medical staff, then follow the rhythm of "simulation — validation — application," step by step, to accumulate capabilities and verify safety. This is precisely what Chaowei Power and PKU Healthcare are doing together — not rushing for quick results, but first laying a solid foundation and clearing the path. A deep coupling of technology and scenarios. The biggest bottleneck for embodied intelligence in healthcare is the lack of an environment for practice and teachers for guidance — both a scarcity of highly realistic medical scenarios and a lack of operational data from highly skilled medical professionals. As a full-stack embodied intelligence large-model enterprise, Chaowei Power possesses a complete technical foundation from data collection and world models to high-fidelity simulation training. PKU Healthcare, on the other hand, provides the most authentic clinical scenarios and the most professional medical experience. The combination of both parties' strengths makes the pragmatic and verifiable implementation path of "simulated training → scenario validation → hospital application" clear and replicable — precisely the approach needed for high-safety scenarios like medical care.

Ambas partes llevarán a cabo innovación conjunta en torno a la recopilación de datos, modelos del mundo y entrenamiento por simulación de la inteligencia incorporada en escenarios médicos, construyendo de manera práctica una ruta completa de implementación desde «entrenamiento simulado» hasta «validación de escenarios» y luego «aplicación hospitalaria». Para que la inteligencia incorporada realmente «entre en el hospital», nunca se trata simplemente de colocar un robot directamente en la sala de pacientes. Primero necesita comprender el hospital, comprender al personal médico y luego, siguiendo el ritmo de «simulación — verificación — aplicación», paso a paso.
